svg.title: Featured AI product: FundBot, a mutual fund assistant that refuses to guess. A facts only FAQ assistant over four Mirae Asset schemes; every answer is short and carries the official source link and the date that source was last read. Pipeline: guardrails (PII, scope, advice) run first; hybrid BM25F and TF IDF retrieval over 47 curated documents; DeepSeek via OpenRouter only rephrases the retrieved passage; the answer carries the source and date. The model never supplies a fact. Release gate results against their floors: top 1 retrieval accuracy 92.7 percent (floor 85), top 3 retrieval accuracy 100 percent (floor 95), answered above the confidence floor 97.6 percent (floor 90), off topic rejected 100 percent (floor 100), competitor questions scoped out 100 percent (floor 100). The confidence floor 0.06 came from a threshold sweep, with zero false answers. CI runs the gate on every push alongside 111 unit tests.

section.h2: FundBot: a mutual fund assistant that refuses to guess.
section.p: A facts only FAQ assistant over four Mirae Asset schemes. Every answer is short, carries the official source link and the date that source was last read, and the system declines when retrieval is not confident.

div.span: PII, scope, advice. Blocked questions never reach the model.
BM25F plus TF IDF over 47 curated documents.
DeepSeek rephrases only. Falls back to the passage.
Source link and the date it was read.
confidence floor, picked by a sweep

div.p: The model never supplies a fact.
41 hand labelled paraphrases, 12 off topic and 5 competitor questions. CI fails the build if any floor is breached.
measured floor that blocks a release
